title: Understanding Mean Squared Error
text: Mean squared error (MSE) is calculated as the average of the squares of the errors. The error is the difference between the predicted value and the actual value.

title: Calculate the Error for Each Group
text: For the first group of $$250$$ inputs, the error is $$1$$. For the second group of $$500$$ inputs, the error is $$-0.5$$. Calculate the squared error for each group.

title: Calculate the Total Squared Error
text: Multiply the squared error by the number of observations in each group to find the total squared error for each group.

title: Find the Mean Squared Error
text: Add the total squared errors from each group and divide by the total number of observations (900) to find the mean squared error.

title: Calculate Squared Errors
text: Calculate the squared error for the first group: $$1^2$$ and for the second group: $${\left(-0.5\right)}^2$$.

title: Calculate Total Squared Error
text: Calculate the total squared error for the first group: $$250\times1^2$$ and for the second group: $$500{\left(-0.5\right)}^2$$.

title: Calculate Mean Squared Error
text: Add the total squared errors: $$250+125$$ and divide by the total number of observations: $$900$$.
